scene: Day 254, late winter afternoon at the edge of a huge grey gravel pit with steep walls. Far below, the beige coach stands at the bottom beside a frozen puddle, and a dark ribbon of thousands of green walkers winds down the single road curving along the inside of the wall, spreading across the floor of the pit toward the coach. On the rim in the foreground, Patch (white round head, orange bandage above his right eye, orange backpack) hauls on a taut rope with both mitten hands, eyes huge, one sweat drop, close to the camera; halfway up the steep wall below him, the woman (round white head, brown driving goggles, long grey scarf) climbs the rope hand over hand while the first walkers reach the coach beneath her. Tense because the whole horde is pouring into the pit and she is still on the wall.

Day 254, dawn at a motorway junction. A bridge at the top of a slip road is packed black with thousands of green walkers from one railing to the other, and all of them are turning at once toward the beige coach waiting at the bottom of the slip road with its headlights on. In the foreground, Patch (white round head, orange bandage above his right eye) leans out of the white truck's window on a frosty farm track, eyes huge, one sweat drop, gripping the door, as the first walkers start to pour down the slip road. Tense because the whole horde is coming down off the bridge at once.
